textbookText: A. Tick the correct alternatives: 1. What does biodiversity refer to? a. The variety of life on Earth b. The number of ecosystems c. The size of different species d. The depth of ocean habitats
2. Which level of biodiversity includes interactions within ecosystems? a. Species Diversity b. Ecological Diversity c. Genetic Diversity d. Environmental Diversity
3. What is the total number of flora species in Nepal? a. 11,861 b. 11,971 c. 12,971 d. 10,971
4. How many species of birds are found in Nepal? a. 871 b. 951 c. 751 d. 771
5. Which of the following is NOT a major cause of biodiversity decline? a. Habitat encroachment b. Climate change c. Eco-friendly farming d. Pollution

6. What is the purpose of Ex-Situ Conservation? a. Protecting organisms in their natural habitats b. Safeguarding animals outside their natural habitats c. Conserving biodiversity within national parks d. Managing wildlife for eco-tourism

7. Which national park is primarily concerned with conserving species such as the royal Bengal tiger, Asiatic wild elephant, and four-horned antelope? a. Banke National Park b. Bardiya National Park c. Chitwan National Park d. Sagarmatha National Park

8. Which national park is famous for being the largest in the country and includes Nepal’s deepest and second-largest lake, Phoksundo Lake? a. Langtang National Park b. Shey-Phoksundo National Park c. Makalu Barun National Park d. Khaptad National Park
